Tap the code to enlarge it, then point a phone camera at it.

Sound

Pop, whistle and thud effects — no music, ever.

Controls

  • Touch: drag anywhere to aim, let go to fire.
  • Mouse: move to aim, click to fire.
  • Keyboard: ◀ ▶ aim  ·  SPACE fire  ·  P pause.

How to play

  • Drag to aim, release to fire. Shots bank off the side walls — use the angles.
  • Connect 3 or more of the same friend and they clear. 10 points each.
  • Faces only fall when they're cut off from the top. A falling face is a RESCUE — 25 points each.
  • Every shot fills the DANGER meter. When it fills, the whole sky drops one row.
  • If any face crosses the bottom line, the game is over.
  • Wind pushes falling rescues sideways — the flag shows which way and how hard. Rain drops them fast and straight.
  • Your shot always flies true — weather never bends your aim.
  • Clear every face to reach the next level: more rows, more friends, faster danger.
